True for items that show a check state, such as the languages in the Language submenu.
The check state. Setting it has no effect: the item's command changes the state, and the state is then read again.
A submenu is always enabled. A leaf item is enabled while its command can execute, and an item without a command is disabled.

The header without the Alt-key underscore, for a menu that has no Alt keys, such as the overflow menu of the tablet layout. A single underscore marks the key and is dropped, a double underscore is one underscore. A fixed text (a file or language name) is data and stays as it is.
Tooltip text, or null. Not translated: it is used for data such as a folder path.
Gets an CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input.IRelayCommand instance wrapping PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Desktop.StatusBarViewModel.ActivateHandTool.
Path length of the selection, for example "Path length: 2,480.6 px". Empty until selections exist.
The translated selection text: "Nothing selected", "1 selected" or "N selected".
The zoom values offered in the drop-down. Each entry carries its own command.
The zoom as shown in the status bar, for example "100%" or "133.33%".
Enabled while the command can execute. A button without a command is disabled.
The translated name, used as the tooltip and as the accessible name.
Two-way for the Node toggle. Unchecking has no effect, because one tool is always active.
Two-way for the Select toggle. Unchecking has no effect, because one tool is always active.
Root of the desktop layout. Adds the menu bar, the toolbar and the status bar to what every shell has (see PressToShape.App.ViewModels.Editor.EditorShellViewModel).

The complete menu structure. The File actions, the Edit actions, the group, arrange, lock and hide items, the Layer menu, Quit, the zoom items, the Window items and the languages have behavior. Everything else has no command and is therefore disabled until its feature exists.

One entry of the menu bar. The header is translated and refreshes when the language changes. A leaf item without a command is disabled. A submenu is always enabled so it can be opened and its (possibly disabled) items inspected. A separator is rendered with the header "-".
Status bar: selection summary on the left, zoom controls on the right.
A toolbar button. Without a command it is disabled until its feature exists.

The toolbar groups from the mockup, left to right: file actions, history, tool toggles, horizontal alignment, transform buttons, vertical alignment, other actions. Position and size are edited in the Properties tab. Undo and Redo work, the other buttons are disabled for now. The Select and Node toggles are wired to the active tool.
